short: The work: the workflow domain crate
is: The workflow domain crate: the commission aggregate and an account's boards, with the ports that store them; I/O-free, built on kernel and identity only (shared allowed).
conventions: Depends on kernel and identity only (shared allowed), never on the domain façade, an adapter or a driver; doc links up a layer are plain code text.
Every element mirrors a design glossary page (`entities/` in the corpus); the page pointer lives in this node's `refs`, never in a doc comment.
Stub modules are allowed, and documented honestly as stubs.

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: kernel, identity, uuid, serde, serde_json (changelog payloads), async-trait, anyhow, thiserror, derive_more, strum; tokio io-util only to name AsyncRead for the streaming FileStore port; dev-deps proptest, chrono, trybuild (the create capability's and the changelog seal's compile-fail cases)

fs.name: proptest-regressions/
fs.role: committed proptest regressions, at the path of each property file under src/ (workflow/position)

fs.name: src/
fs.role: elements (the commission, the boards) + ports (their seams)

fs.name: tests/
fs.role: fact_contract.rs — the Fact contract (commission-anchored evidence blocks hard deletion); ui.rs + ui/ — compile-fail cases: CommissionWrites::create without a capability, and with an AsOwner one; the changelog's seal: a NewChangelogEntry built from outside (E0451), a gated kind passed to event (E0308), with_note on a gated entry (E0599)

notes: See also: the design corpus glossary — `entities/` in ZurNetwork/zurfur-design, indexed by `docs/design-index.md`.
See also: ZMVP-67 (tests/fact_contract.rs: the Fact contract's origin ticket).
